description: Use it when the user wants a track's tempo, beats, bars, drop or ending. Reads a music track's tempo, beats, bars, drop and ending, and writes FIT.md (the tempo, the drop and the other drop candidates, where sections start, how it ends and any warning), cues.json (beats and bars in seconds, and as frames at 30 a second) and seams.png (the track with its bars). It changes no track, and saves in a folder of its own, apart from fit_music's for the same track. Its tempo tells which launch film look the track suits. Use it before fit_music to pick hit and drop. To fit the track, use fit_music instead. The music playbook (makersmcp_playbook) has the whole job. (musicfit 0.2.2, on this machine.)

bpm.description: The tempo, when the one found is half or double the real one; FIT.md warns when it could be (default: found).

meter.description: Beats to a bar, "3" or "4", when FIT.md warns the bars may have the other (default: found).

out_dir.description: Folder to save into, absolute or relative to /tmp/churn-4a3i6zrn. Default: musicfit-<track-name>.analysis, where <track-name> is the name of track without its extension. A run replaces the files an earlier run of this kit left there, so give each version its own out_dir.

track.description: The music file, or a video whose sound to read.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, counted from the start of the call, before returning a job_id to wait on. Some clients end a call after 60 or 240 seconds; 45 is safe in all of them.

name: analyze_music

continued.description: True when this call continued the job an identical call started, instead of starting another.

docs.description: The notes the text shows, and where each one is.

expires_at.description: When the download links stop working.

url.description: Where to download the file, when the job ran on a server.

folder.description: Where the kit saved its files.

last_line.description: What the kit was doing last.

next.description: What to do next, as the Next line says.

passed.description: For checks: whether the check passed.

title: Read a music track
